verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own docs refer to a per-state report that AutoFile migrates into the sales tax return, plus an archive of historical sales tax data and general reporting. That suggests jurisdiction-level, filing-ready detail exists, but the evidence is thin and indirect. missing for 10: real-time accrued liability view by jurisdiction, collected-versus-owed reconciliation, documented export formats for accountants, GL/ERP export or integration for liability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment — collected versus owed, filing-ready detail, and exports my accountant and GL can consume

citations.quote: TaxJar electronically migrates your state report to your sales tax return, eliminating manual searches and errors – ensuring accurate, on-time filings.
we’ll cover everything you need to know about handling sales tax calculations, reporting, and filing for your own platform.
